q.x: > One thing I do remember though is how odd it felt looking at yourself in a mirror without your image being mirrored. Not sure my brain was ready for that one after thousands of years of looking at itself in mirrored surfaces.

desc:
Now! High quality version at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P1ww1IXRfTA
Richard Feynman amuses himself with an old puzzle - why do mirrors seem to switch left and right, but not top and bottom? From the BBC TV series 'Fun To Imagine' (1983). You can now watch higher quality versions of some of these episodes at www.bbc.co.uk/archive/feynman/

recs.stt: Why Do Mirrors Flip Things Horizontally but Not Vertically? Here's the Physics
